request.query: multivariate integer polynomials naive coefficient height at most B and multidegree at most r

items.name: MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree
items.type: (σ : Type u) → (R : Type v) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → ℕ → Submodule R (MvPolynomial σ R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.mem_restrictTotalDegree
items.type:
∀ (σ : Type u) {R : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] (m : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  p ∈ MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree σ R m ↔ p.totalDegree ≤ m

items.name: MvPolynomial.instFiniteSubtypeMemSubmoduleRestrictTotalDegreeOfFinite
items.type:
∀ (σ : Type u) (R : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] [Finite σ] (N : ℕ),
  Module.Finite R ↥(MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree σ R N)

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreesLE
items.type: (R : Type u) → (σ : Type u_1) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → Multiset σ → Submodule R (MvPolynomial σ R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree_iff_sup
items.type:
∀ (σ : Type u) {R : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ),
  p ∈ MvPolynomial.restrictDegree σ R n ↔ ∀ (i : σ), Multiset.count i p.degrees ≤ n
